The characteristic red stitching is visible but partially obscured by grime and shadow. There appears to be black marker writing or a logo on the side of the ball.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The black marking resembles text or a logo but is structurally incoherent and illegible. The characters melt into each other and lack sharp edges, which is a classic AI generation artifact when attempting to render typography on curved surfaces. This is a moderate-to-severe semantic error.

Some segments of the red stitching appear to blend softly into the leather rather than sitting distinctly on top. While this could be due to image resolution or dirt, the lack of crisp boundary definition suggests slight generative smoothing artifacts.

The edge of the ball in the deep shadow is soft. This is likely due to photographic depth-of-field or lighting falloff rather than a structural defect, so severity is low. It is noted but not considered a critical failure.
